content.doc: Every artifact begins with an archive header. It is the identity card of the object. It answers: who made it, when, why, what state it is in, which templates built it. The header is read-only. It is stamped at first reconstruction and never modified — only upgraded by creating a new artifact with parentId pointing to this one.
